---
title: "Forward-Backward and Posterior Decoding"
---

## Core Question

What is the total probability of the observed sequence, and how likely is each state at each position?

## Lesson Scaffold

- Contrast sum-product with max-product.
- Derive the forward recurrence.
- Compute likelihood of observations.
- Derive the backward recurrence.
- Combine forward and backward variables into posterior state probabilities.
- Compare Viterbi path and marginal posterior decoding.
- Introduce scaling or log-sum-exp for numerical stability.
